• Multi-engine transcription — local Whisper, Premiere Pro native, and cloud fallback
• Story Cutter: speaker names at every cut, unlimited /batch, named batch sections, stop mid-execution
• Grok Imagine Quality mode for higher-fidelity image generation
• Premiere Pro 2025 + 2026 compatibility (host range widened)
• Pipeline reliability improvements throughout
